# Additional source-field notice

DeFiLlama is the source of tvl-chain-other-metrics-real-sources.json. This file projects selected real fields from the same22November2026 public catalogs used by the main chain-scope fixture. Exact URLs, complete catalog wire hashes/byte counts, capture time and deterministic subject selection are in provenance. Measurements and key spelling/case are unchanged.

Source: https://api.llama.fi/protocols . Related chain catalog: https://api.llama.fi/v2/chains . Publisher metric descriptions: https://docs.llama.fi/faqs/frequently-asked-questions . No third-party data relicensing or independent on-chain audit is claimed.

Additional controls isolate actual vesting/offers/treasury/OwnTokens source keys, including the genuine zero-valued offers fields, rather than inventing positive inputs. Named-chain projections retain actual source fields only. These are parser controls, not separately published full API responses or live-outage evidence. No other-provider handler, account/key, paid API or transaction was used.
